_description: Operator catalog for Fundamental Alpha expressions. Each operator defines a function callable in alpha expressions. Add new operators by appending to this file. The 'numpy_impl' field is Python code (using np, pd) that implements the operator for validation.
_convention: Use 'x', 'y' for array args, 'n' for window, 'a' for scalar. Arrays are 1D numpy float64 in (date x symbol) panel order.

operators.name: rank
operators.description: Cross-sectional percentile rank [0,1]. NaN-safe: ignores NaN values.
operators.numpy_impl:
def rank(x):
    x=np.asarray(x,float);n=len(x);v=~np.isnan(x);r=np.full(n,np.nan)
    if v.sum()==0:return r
    xv=x[v];o=np.argsort(xv);rk=np.empty(len(xv));rk[o]=np.arange(1,len(xv)+1)/len(xv);r[v]=rk;return r

operators.name: zscore
operators.description: Cross-sectional z-score: (x - mean(x)) / std(x).
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x: (x-np.nanmean(x))/np.nanstd(x) if np.nanstd(x)>0 else np.zeros_like(x)

operators.name: scale
operators.description: Rescale so sum of absolute values equals a.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,a=1: x*a/np.nansum(np.abs(x)) if np.nansum(np.abs(x))>0 else x

operators.name: demean
operators.description: Subtract cross-sectional mean: x - mean(x).

operators.name: winsorize
operators.description: Cross-sectional winsorize: clip x to mean ± n*std.

operators.name: fillna_median
operators.description: Replace NaN with the cross-sectional median (fundamental panels have sparse coverage).

operators.name: ts_rank
operators.description: Rolling time-series percentile rank over n periods.

operators.name: ts_zscore
operators.description: Rolling z-score over n periods.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: pd.Series(x).rolling(n,min_periods=1).apply(lambda v: (v[-1]-np.nanmean(v))/np.nanstd(v) if np.nanstd(v)>0 else 0,raw=True).values

operators.name: ts_mean
operators.description: Rolling mean over n periods.

operators.name: ts_std
operators.description: Rolling standard deviation over n periods.

operators.name: ts_max
operators.description: Rolling maximum over n periods.

operators.name: ts_min
operators.description: Rolling minimum over n periods.

operators.name: ts_sum
operators.description: Rolling sum over n periods.

operators.name: ts_argmax
operators.description: Days since the rolling maximum occurred within the last n bars.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: pd.Series(x).rolling(n,min_periods=1).apply(lambda v: len(v)-1-np.argmax(v) if len(v)>0 else 0,raw=True).values

operators.name: ts_argmin
operators.description: Days since the rolling minimum occurred within the last n bars.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: pd.Series(x).rolling(n,min_periods=1).apply(lambda v: len(v)-1-np.argmin(v) if len(v)>0 else 0,raw=True).values

operators.name: correlation
operators.description: Rolling Pearson correlation between x and y over n periods.

operators.name: decay_linear
operators.description: Linear-decay weighted moving average over n periods (newer values weight more).
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: pd.Series(np.asarray(x,float)).rolling(n,min_periods=1).apply(lambda v: np.sum(v*np.arange(1,len(v)+1))/np.sum(np.arange(1,len(v)+1)) if len(v)>0 else v[0],raw=True).values

operators.name: delay
operators.description: Lag x by n periods. n MUST be ≥ 1 to avoid look-ahead bias.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: np.concatenate([np.full(n, np.nan), np.asarray(x[:-n], float)]) if n>0 else np.asarray(x,float)

operators.name: delta
operators.description: Difference: x - delay(x, n). n MUST be ≥ 1.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n: np.asarray(x,float)-np.concatenate([np.full(n, np.nan), np.asarray(x[:-n], float)]) if n>0 else np.zeros_like(np.asarray(x,float))

operators.name: returns
operators.description: Percentage change over n periods. n MUST be ≥ 1.
operators.numpy_impl: lambda x,n=1: np.asarray(x,float)/np.concatenate([np.full(n, np.nan), np.asarray(x[:-n], float)])-1 if n>0 else np.zeros_like(np.asarray(x,float))

operators.name: sign
operators.description: Sign of x: -1, 0, or +1.

operators.name: abs
operators.description: Absolute value of x.

operators.name: log
operators.description: Natural logarithm. Input is clamped to ≥ 1e-8 for safety.

operators.name: power
operators.description: x raised to power n.

operators.name: signed_power
operators.description: sign(x) * abs(x)^n — preserves sign through power.

operators.name: min
operators.description: Element-wise minimum of x and y.

operators.name: max
operators.description: Element-wise maximum of x and y.

operators.name: clip
operators.description: Clip values to [lower, upper].

_llm_extensions_note: When generating alphas, the LLM may propose NEW operators not in this catalog. Add them to this file with a numpy_impl, then re-run validation. Unimplemented operators are flagged with a warning but do not block validation — the expression is accepted if all named operators exist in the catalog.
